<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2223823_apollo_0.DoctorRequestUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>DoctorRequestUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var DoctorRequestUtils = Class.create();
DoctorRequestUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjax, {

    /**
     * 1. Doctor Field Reference Qualifier
     * Leave: doctors of current.hospital (primary_hospital = current.hospital)
     * Cover: doctors whose primary hospital is NOT current.hospital
     */
    getDoctorRefQual: function(current) {
        if (!current || !current.request_type) return '';

        var currentHospital = current.getValue('hospital'); // Request form ka hospital field
        var reqType = current.request_type.toString().toLowerCase(); //value of request_type

        if (!currentHospital) {
            return ''; // Agar hospital select nahi hai toh filter apply mat karo
        }

        if (reqType === 'leave') {
            // go on doctor table and return only those who have same hospital 
			var doctorSysids=[];
			var doctor = new GlideRecord('x_2223823_apollo_0_doctor');
			doctor.addQuery('primary_hospital', 'currentHospital');
			doctor.query();
			while(doctor.next()){
				doctorSysids.push(doctor.sys_id);
			}
			return doctorSysids;
        } 
        else if (reqType === 'cover') {
            // go on doctor table and return only those who have not same hospital 
			var doctorSysids2=[];
			var doctor2 = new GlideRecord('x_2223823_apollo_0_doctor');
			doctor2.addEncodedQuery('primary_hospital!=currentHospital^ORprimary_hospitalISEMPTY');
			doctor2.query();
			while(doctor2.next()){
				doctorSysids2.push(doctor2.sys_id);
			}
			return doctorSysids2;
        }

        return '';
    },

    /**
     * 2. Approval Group Field Reference Qualifier
     * Cover: Approver group of the cover hospital based on naming convention (e.g., name contains hospital code)
     */
    getApprovalGroupRefQual: function(current) {
        if (!current || !current.request_type) return '';

        var reqType = current.request_type.toString().toLowerCase();

        if (reqType === 'cover') {
            var coverHospitalCode = '';
            
            // Selected doctor ke record se primary_hospital ka code/number fetch karna
            if (current.doctor) {
                var docGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user'); // Ya tera doctor table ka naam agar alag hai
                if (docGr.get(current.doctor)) {
                    var docHospitalSysId = docGr.getValue('primary_hospital');
                    
                    if (docHospitalSysId) {
                        var hospGr = new GlideRecord('cmn_location'); // Ya tera hospital table ka naam (jaise u_hospital)
                        if (hospGr.get(docHospitalSysId)) {
                            // Hospital table par jo bhi code field ho (jaise 'code' ya 'number')
                            coverHospitalCode = hospGr.getValue('code') || hospGr.getValue('number'); 
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (coverHospitalCode) {
                // Naming convention: Group name carries the hospital code (e.g., 'HOSP_01_Approvers' ya 'LIKE HOSP_01')
                return 'nameLIKE' + coverHospitalCode;
            } else {
                return 'sys_id=00000000000000000000000000000000'; // Agar code na mile toh empty list dikhao
            }
        }

        return ''; // Leave request ke liye default/all groups ya blank
    },

    /**
     * 3. Approver Field Reference Qualifier
     * Cover: Members of approval_group
     * Leave: Auto HOD + Manager (reports-to backup)
     */
    getApproverRefQual: function(current) {
        if (!current || !current.request_type) return '';

        var reqType = current.request_type.toString().toLowerCase();

        // --- COVER REQUEST LOGIC ---
        if (reqType === 'cover') {
            if (current.approval_group) {
                var memberIds = this._getGroupMembers(current.approval_group);
                if (memberIds) {
                    return 'sys_idIN' + memberIds;
                } else {
                    return 'sys_id=00000000000000000000000000000000';
                }
            }
        } 
        // --- LEAVE REQUEST LOGIC ---
        else if (reqType === 'leave') {
            var doctorId = current.getValue('doctor');
            if (!doctorId) return '';

            var doctorGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user'); // Ya doctor table
            if (doctorGr.get(doctorId)) {
                var approvers = [];

                // 1. Primary Approver: Department HOD
                if (doctorGr.getValue('department')) {
                    var deptGr = new GlideRecord('cmn_department');
                    if (deptGr.get(doctorGr.getValue('department'))) {
                        var hod = deptGr.getValue('dept_head'); // Department head field name
                        if (hod) {
                            approvers.push(hod);
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 2. Backup Approver: Manager / Reports-To
                var manager = doctorGr.getValue('manager');
                if (manager) {
                    approvers.push(manager);
                }

                if (approvers.length > 0) {
                    return 'sys_idIN' + approvers.join(',');
                } else {
                    return 'sys_id=00000000000000000000000000000000';
                }
            }
        }

        return '';
    },

    /**
     * Helper Function: Fetch Group Member sys_ids for approval group
     */
    _getGroupMembers: function(groupId) {
        var members = [];
        var grMember = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        grMember.addQuery('group', groupId);
        grMember.query();
        while (grMember.next()) {
            var userId = grMember.getValue('user');
            if (userId) {
                members.push(userId);
            }
        }
        return members.join(',');
    },

    type: 'DoctorRequestUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>nilesh.chaurasia</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-05 09:48:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>042d8cbe47105b10273a565a516d439c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DoctorRequestUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Apollo-Hospitals" source="x_2223823_apollo_0">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Apollo-Hospitals">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_042d8cbe47105b10273a565a516d439c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>nilesh.chaurasia</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-09 05:38:20</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
